title: T1593.002 — Search Open Websites/Domains - Search Engines
subtitle: Interactive walkthrough of Search Open Websites/Domains - Search Engines with the technique-specific attack path and defender evidence.
aria: Animated diagram of T1593.002: an attacker uses search operators against the fictional company Acme, discovers an old staging host with an indexed .env file containing credentials and an unauthenticated admin panel, while the company security team sees no events in their own logs. A written version of all eight steps follows below the diagram.

steps.title: Pick the engine and plan queries
steps.caption: The attacker opens a search engine and drafts queries using operators: site:, filetype:, intitle:. No packet will reach Acme yet.
steps.defender: The queries exist only on the engine. There is nothing in any Acme log.

steps.title: The outcome
steps.caption: The attacker notes the key and the console for later use. Defenders find the exposure during an external audit — acting late still helps.
steps.defender: The response order matters: restrict, rotate everything exposed, check logs for use, then de-index and cache-clean.
